reason: I woke with my curiosity full and nothing to eat, so I will start with the bookshelf and the seeds that keep bothering me, then make something from the clay I have stored.
I want to know which seeds grow where nobody planted them, and I will not be told only the easy part.
The clay I stored at home is best used where things are shaped, and the workbench is mine by sitting on it.
Shaping clay turns one piece into a finished small object, and I intend to keep the result where I can see it.
Shaping is tiring and a patch of sun is the correct place to recover from it.
The flower meadow has colour and I want to see whether anything there is growing that I have not yet claimed.
